evidence.reason: The stopped-state guard only reads `ActiveState`. systemd can report `inactive` for a unit whose start job is still queued, so `inactive()` can pass while `crq-repair.service` has a pending start job. That defeats the intended refusal to switch while any CRQ unit could run, allowing the queued repair service to start during the checkout. The check should also inspect the unit's job/pending-job state, or otherwise prevent queued start jobs from running during the switch.
